name: Heap / Top K
summary: Keep only the K best elements in a priority queue. You never need the whole order, only the top K, so you never pay for a full sort.
signal: top K, kth largest/smallest, k closest, repeatedly remove min or max
mentalModel: Priority queue that keeps the K elements that matter right now.
recognitionRules: The question asks for the K largest, smallest, most frequent or closest items.
The input arrives as a stream and you must answer at any moment.
You repeatedly remove the smallest or largest element.
You need the median of a changing dataset.
Sorting everything is possible but the question only cares about K elements.
template: heap = new PriorityQueue<>()   // min-heap by default
heap.pop()      // drop the worst element we no longer need
invariant: The heap always holds the K best elements seen so far.
